construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Metal precision amplifying Metal — same-polarity self-referencing loop
candidates.k2_overview: Your Metal moves as the Twin: a standing force that meets the world edge-first and equal. Nothing about you waits for permission. You hold your line the way a blade holds its shape, and you respect exactly the people who hold theirs. Company, for you, is two swords in one sheath: close, parallel, never fused.
candidates.k2_functional: Your energy is tempered and even: slow to tire, slow to bend, restored by solitary work.

k2_domain_readings.Peers: Your peers are fellow blades: rivals you respect, colleagues you measure against, friends won through tested mettle. Keep two or three whose standards match yours. Iron sharpens iron is not a proverb to you. It is your social life.
k2_domain_readings.Independence: Independence, in metal, is structural: you do not perform autonomy, you are made of it. Guard it without sealing it. A blade alone stays sharp but unused, and your edge exists for work that matters.
k2_domain_readings.Self-reliance: You carry your own weight and everyone can feel it. The practice to add is borrowing well: one tool, one favor, one opinion at a time. Even the finest steel was forged by other hands.

angles.drive: You built your own standard with no one watching. Making a thing yourself feels safer than being measured on it, so you build alone rather than with help. Let one favour into the making, since you pay most for the things you make alone.
angles.cost_self: Whenever something matters, you make it yourself and let no one offer. Making it alone proves the standard is yours, and doing without help comes ahead of going to bed. Ask for a hand early, or everything self-made costs you rest you never take.
angles.cost_others: Making everything yourself is what you show a new peer first. By making each thing alone instead of sharing it, you leave your peers nothing to carry. Hand one piece over, because all you take from them is the chance to matter to you.

angles.drive: You hold everyone to the same measure as yourself. Fairness feels cleaner to you than favour, so being even with someone comes ahead of being easy on them. Let a friend off the hook sometimes, since you keep everyone you measure at a distance.
angles.cost_self: Whenever a friend falls short of the measure, you keep the measure rather than the friend. Holding everyone to one even standard is how you stay honest. Bend it once for someone you like, because you spend long stretches without company that fits.
angles.cost_others: Being even-handed with a friend is how you show respect. You hold people you like to your own measure, and hand them your standard ahead of your warmth. Offer the warmth first, as you cost them the ease of being liked without being graded.

angles.drive: Your strength recovers alone and gets spent in company. Being seen low feels like a debt you never repay, so you recover quietly instead of calling anyone. Let one person near while you are low, because you recover slower alone than you need to.
angles.cost_self: Out of sight is where you recover until whole again. Arriving half-built feels worse than arriving late, and you take the long quiet over the quick ask. Show someone the half-built version before recovering alone costs you the friend who would have come.
angles.cost_others: Recovering alone spares the people near you your worst days. You return recovered rather than being seen recovering, and give them the finished version only. Let them in on one of those days, since you deny your closest people the chance to be needed.

angles.drive: You stay sealed off long after the reason has gone. There is Metal to spare in you, so you seal yourself off from help without noticing whether you want any. You seal out the people you want as much as the risk.
angles.cost_self: A hurt is the first thing you seal off, before anyone notices. Needing no one proves you are fine, and you keep it sealed instead of letting help in. You carry each hurt alone, and you lose evenings you could have shared.
angles.cost_others: Sealing everyone off politely keeps you easy to live with. You give them calm with nothing under it, your sealed quiet ahead of their wish to come in. Remember that you meant to seal out the hurt, never your peers.

angles.drive: Being taught lands on you as an attack first and information second. With Metal running over, you put your own judgment ahead of any peer's lesson. You are taught only by people you let be right, and you rarely let them.
angles.cost_self: Whenever someone tries to teach you, you check the messenger first. Since being right is how you stay safe, you defend a position rather than learn from it. You lose every lesson that needed you to be wrong before it could teach you.
angles.cost_others: Teaching the people around you comes easier than being taught. Your standard sits above theirs by default, and you hand out the fix ahead of the question. You leave your peers no turn at being right.

angles.drive: Asking once costs you more than doing a thing twice yourself. Metal is heavy in you, so asking reads as failure and carrying alone reads as proof. You count the asking as a cost and leave the carrying off the bill.
angles.cost_self: Where a job is heavy, you take it all instead of asking for half. To prove you are enough, you carry it alone and spend sleep before spending one question. You pay in lost sleep for help you never ask for.
angles.cost_others: Being nobody's burden is why you ask no one. Since you would rather owe nothing than be joined, you take the job back the moment someone offers. You send away the peer who offered and leave them no way to help you.

edge.lead: Metal runs through your family, your growth and your social life. It is the weight you carry at home without being asked, the standard you keep raising in private, and the friend who walks beside people rather than ahead of them.
